mapper.select: SELECT role FROM users WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (student_id, name, email, password, avatar_url, major, role, status, verified_status, disabled_reason, score, points, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{name}, #{email}, #{password}, #{avatarUrl}, #{major}, #{role}, #{status}, #{verifiedStatus}, #{disabledReason}, #{score}, #{points}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET student_id = #{studentId}, name = #{name}, email = #{email}, password = #{password}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, major = #{major}, role = #{role}, status = #{status}, verified_status = #{verifiedStatus}, disabled_reason = #{disabledReason}, score = #{score}, points = #{points}, last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET points = points + #{points}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET score = #{score}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET status = #{status}, disabled_reason = #{disabledReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET verified_status = #{verifiedStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
